Alec — thanks, great questions. Short answers up front, followed by recommended options and next steps. Attached: logging-redaction-diagram.png (simple flow).

Answers:
- "Request/response logs" can include headers and trace IDs; by default Redwood logs a minimal request trace for troubleshooting, but all logging behavior is configurable per-customer.
- We support both: ingress redaction (recommended) where we mask/strip sensitive fields before persisting, and post-ingest processing for cases where teams want richer telemetry but still must redact before long-term storage. Ingress redaction ensures sensitive values never touch object storage.
- Yes — per-customer region controls for logs are supported. You can pin persistence to the US or EU region; we also provide an audit trail showing where logs live.

Recommended approaches (tradeoffs):
1) Ingress redaction (best for compliance) — we apply rule-based redaction at the gateway: remove or replace PII, strip specified headers, and hash trace IDs. Minimal latency impact; ensures no sensitive values are persisted.
2) Sampled telemetry + redaction pipeline — keep full data in short-lived ephemeral storage for debugging (configurable TTL e.g., 1–2 days) then run redaction before moving to long-term storage. Good for debugging but requires tight access controls.
3) Header-level allowlist — only persist allowed headers; drop everything else. Low storage and simple to validate.

Technical controls we offer:
- Rule engine for redaction (regex + JSON path) configurable per-tenant.
- KMS/HSM integration for deterministic hashing of trace IDs and key management for reversible masking when permitted.
- Retention policies per customer (30 / 90 / 365 days) and immediate purge endpoints for legal requests.
- Audit logs and exportable proof of redaction operations for SOC 2 evidence.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick technical walkthrough with Evelyn (cc'd), our security engineer, to validate the ingress redaction flow — 30 minutes.
- We’ll share the attached diagram and a one-page tech note for your security team to review.
- Rishi will confirm any commercial impact for retention beyond the baseline offering.

Proposed times: Wed 2027-06-30 10:30 PT or Thu 2027-07-01 11:00 PT. Which works for you?

Thanks,
Marissa
